answer: Because the timing is recorded against the vault challenge, the jade audit can replay the prism history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 128 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 3761 identities would post 2889 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
